title: Check whether sed is GNU (Linux) or BSD (macOS)
summary: Linux and macOS ship different versions of sed, the text editing tool. Check which one you have, because some options work only on one of them.

aliases.text: which sed version do i have
sed на маке и на линуксе разница

steps.explain: Ask sed for its version. On Linux the first line says 'sed (GNU sed)' followed by a version number, which means GNU sed. On macOS use the variant instead, because macOS sed does not support --version.
steps.expect: Linux: a line like 'sed (GNU sed) 4.9', which means GNU sed. macOS (variant): a line ending in 'General Commands Manual', which means BSD sed.

source.title: sed manual; card written and verified in the lnxhelp sandbox
